apps.localizedDescription: Tsumiru is a native client for reading manga & manhwa from a Suwayomi-Server instance, built for long webtoon binges. Offline downloads with an on-device catalog, a rebuilt continuous-scroll webtoon reader, incognito mode, and 13 built-in themes.

versions.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added **Custom HTTP headers** for servers behind an authentication gateway, Zero Trust guard, or reverse proxy (@Yukaii)
- Added an optional **Internal / LAN URL** alongside your **Server URL**, with an **Active connection** row showing whether you are **Using LAN** or **Using remote** (@SuperMario22922)
- Tapping a series in **On device** now opens **Downloaded chapters**, with **Retry** and **Remove from device** on each row (@ariqpradipa)
- Stalled downloads now show a banner saying why, with a **Retry** button (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Chapter grouping** to the **Updates** filters, with **Collapsed** and **Expanded** modes (@yohanim)
- Added **Download files in the background**, so background checks can fetch chapters instead of only queueing them (@yohanim)
- Added **Keep recently-read chapters downloaded**, which re-downloads keep-window chapters if they go missing (@yohanim)
- Extensions can now be repaired with **Reinstall** (@aaronbamblett)

### ⚙️ Changes

- The **Server** downloads tab is now the same list as **On device**, with a **Queue** header and a page count on the active download (@aaronbamblett)
- The server queue now reorders by long press or the drag handle, and each row has **Retry**, **Cancel**, **Move to top** and **Move to bottom** (@aaronbamblett)
- **Continuous horizontal** reading modes now scroll continuously instead of a page at a time (@yohanim)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Queued downloads that Android refuses to start now stay visible and recoverable instead of disappearing (@aaronbamblett)
- Background downloads can now resume on their own without you reopening the app (@aaronbamblett)
- Pause and Wi-Fi only preferences are kept when downloads recover (@aaronbamblett)
- Switching server or account no longer lets downloads carry on with old credentials (@aaronbamblett)
- Chapters your server cannot produce are now given up on after a few attempts instead of asked for forever (@yohanim)
- Background downloads no longer hang on a dead connection (@yohanim)
- Background warnings and errors now reach the in-app debug log (@yohanim)
- Applying a **Keep offline** rule to several series now shows one continuous progress count (@yohanim)
- Chapters found by a library update now finish downloading without opening the series (@yohanim)
- When a chapter in your **Keep offline** rule cannot be downloaded, the next unread chapter takes its place (@yohanim)
- Library search stays responsive on large libraries (@yohanim)
- Long strips with page cropping on now scroll more smoothly and use less memory (@yohanim)
- The **On device** list no longer stutters while a download is running (@yohanim)
- The library's **On device** badge and filter now update as downloads finish (@yohanim)
- Offline download indicators now appear before the server connection is established (@ariqpradipa)
- Extension errors now show a readable message instead of a wall of code (@aaronbamblett)
- The login and **Basic Auth** dialogs now submit when you press Enter (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed logins on macOS not surviving a restart (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Simple Login** rejecting valid credentials on Android, iOS and desktop (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Browse** source filters resetting each time you reopened them (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Reset** in the source filters leaving the old results on screen (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed pinch zoom drifting away from the point between your fingers (@yohanim)
- Fixed zooming near the top or bottom of a page pushing it out of view (@yohanim)
- Fixed the webtoon reader jumping to the previous chapter on a small scroll near the top (@yohanim)
- Fixed the webtoon reader loading the next chapter too early on long chapters (@yohanim)
- Fixed returning to the previous chapter landing at the top of a tall page (@yohanim)
- Fixed date headers on **Updates** repeating as you scrolled (@yohanim)
- Fixed chapters read on another device ignoring your delete-while-reading settings (@yohanim)
- Fixed a chapter with no pages spinning as downloading forever (@yohanim)
- Fixed the download notification flashing in a loop for a chapter that fails immediately (@yohanim)
- Fixed the tracker using the wrong setting for chapters you marked read while offline (@yohanim)
- Fixed switching servers leaving the app retrying a sign-in against the old one (@yohanim)
- Fixed a crash when marking several chapters read at once (@yohanim)
- Fixed crashes when deleting a chapter from the server after leaving the screen (@yohanim)
- Fixed a crash loop in the library category tabs (@yohanim)
- Fixed installing an extension from an empty file appearing to succeed on web (@yohanim)
- Fixed the app asking your server for the same chapters twice while catching up on new ones (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Download to server** queueing chapters your server already had (@aaronbamblett)

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-x64.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://suwayomi.github.io/Suwayomi-Tsumiru/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru
```

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)
